app_archetype: Dashboard / Internal SaaS Admin Operations Tool
target_audience: Shopify SEO Managers, Ecommerce Operations Specialists, Technical SEO Auditors
design_mission: Create a high-density, authoritative, tactical desktop-first Shopify SEO management command center for 35,000+ catalog items. It balances high data correlation, explainable 0-100 SEO scoring, zero-risk safety guardrails (SEO-only write restrictions), and rapid batch workflows with Swiss Brutalist contrast and crystal-clear visual hierarchy.

theme_strategy.dark_theme_personality: Deep Slate & Tactical Obsidian (#090D16, #0F172A, #1E293B) with crisp 1px borders (#334155), electric cyan & amber status indicators, and luminous green health accents.
theme_strategy.light_theme_personality: Clean Swiss Surgical White & Neutral Canvas (#F8FAFC, #FFFFFF) with sharp contrast slate borders (#E2E8F0) and vibrant semantic indicators.

typography.pairing_archetype: The Old Money Tech & Swiss Brutalist Hybrid
typography.font_family_body: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
typesetting_rules: Overlines & Meta Badges MUST be uppercase with tracking-[0.15em] and font-mono
Headings strictly use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter with font-semibold or font-bold
Character counters (e.g. 52/60, 148/160) MUST use font-mono for zero jitter during typing
Never use Inter for Main page headings; use Outfit or Cabinet Grotesk

critical_red.meaning: Critical SEO Issues / Missing SEO Title or Meta Description / Score 0-49

draft_blue.meaning: Draft / Staged / In-Progress AI Run / Pending Shopify Sync

sidebar.type: Fixed collapsible desktop navigation (w-64 expanded, w-20 collapsed)
sidebar.brand_header: UrbanDotted SEO Operations + Live Shopify Store Badge (35,420 Items)
sidebar.safety_guardrail_banner: SEO-Only Guardrail Active: Commerce fields (Price, Inventory, SKU) are strictly read-only locked.

elements: Global Quick Search (Cmd+K) for products, collections, SKUs
Shopify Store Sync Status (Connected: urbandotted.myshopify.com • Synced 2m ago)
Pending Sync Counter badge (e.g. '14 Drafts Ready to Publish')
Quick Batch Action trigger button
Theme toggle (Dark/Light)
Operator Profile (SEO Lead)

sections.name: Global Health Hero Bento
components: Overall SEO Health Score Gauge (e.g. 74/100 - Good with +4.2% this week)

sections.name: Audit Radar & Issue Categories Breakdown
components: Issue Queue Distribution Bar (Missing Title, Missing Description, Over 60 chars, Over 160 chars, Missing Image Alt Text, Keyword Cannibalization)
Collection SEO Readiness Donut Chart (112 Optimised / 30 Missing)
SEO Velocity & Activity Sparklines (Daily automated & manual fixes)

sections.name: High-Priority Action Queues
components: Top 5 High-Traffic Products with Missing SEO
Recent Batch Jobs Quick Status Widget

screen_2_products_list.title: Products SEO Table & Issue-Category Queues
features: Queue Tabs with live count badges: [All (35,420), Missing SEO (3,410), Critical Issues (2,240), Needs Improvement (10,830), Good (12,450), Fully Optimised (6,490), Drafts/Staged (42)]
Server-side simulated fast pagination (25, 50, 100 rows per page)
Deep Filtering: By Collection, Product Type, Vendor, Price tier, Missing Alt Count, SEO Score Range (0-100), Status

Row Information: Thumbnail, Product Title (read-only), SKU & Inventory (with lock icon), Current SEO Title & Meta snippet, Character counts, Live Score badge (0-100), Status badge (Good/Yellow/Red/Draft), Action button 'Open Live Editor'
Batch Actions Toolbar: Multi-select rows -> 'Generate AI SEO in Batch', 'Publish to Shopify', 'Revert to Shopify Original', 'Mark as Reviewed'

screen_3_live_seo_editor.title: Live SEO Editor with Read-Only Commerce Safety Lock

left_panel.title: Shopify Commerce Data (READ ONLY)
elements: Product Primary Image & Media Gallery (with Alt Text Quick-Edit pills)
Shopify Product Title (Lock icon, copy button)
Product Handle / Slug (/products/urban-oversized-heavyweight-hoodie-black)
Vendor, Product Type, Tags, Collections List
SKU: UBD-HD-001 • Inventory: 428 in stock • Price: $89.00 • Status: Active (All with lock icons)
Shopify Description HTML Preview snippet

center_panel.title: SEO Live Fields & SERP Preview
elements: SEO Title Input: Live character counter (e.g. 54 / 60 char max recommended), colored progress bar (Green: 45-60, Yellow: 30-44 or 61-70, Red: <30 or >70). Auto-variables button ({{title}} | {{vendor}} | UrbanDotted).

SEO Meta Description Textarea: Live character counter (e.g. 148 / 160 char max recommended), colored progress meter (Green: 130-160, Yellow: 100-129 or 161-175, Red: <100 or >175). Auto-variables button ({{title}}, {{price}}, {{tags}}).
Image Alt Text Matrix: List of all product images with live alt text input & 'Auto-generate descriptive Alt' action.

Live Google SERP Preview Card (Desktop & Mobile view toggles): Realistic Google Search Result with favicon, url breadcrumbs, bold keywords matching query, title truncated with ellipsis if >60 chars, snippet truncated if >160 chars.
Action Toolbar: 'Save as Draft', 'Publish Immediately to Shopify', 'AI Rewrite Suggestions', 'Discard Changes'

right_panel.title: Explainable 0-100 SEO Score & Rules Engine
elements: Circular SEO Score Dial (0-100) with rating pill (e.g. '92 - EXCELLENT')
Score Impact Breakdown: Positives (+ Points) & Problems (- Deductions)

Rules Checklist: (1) Primary keyword in title (+20), (2) Optimal title length 45-60c (+15), (3) Unique meta description (+15), (4) Description length 130-160c (+15), (5) Call-to-action in snippet (+10), (6) Brand suffix attached (+10), (7) Alt text on all images (+15)
AI Optimization Assistant Drawer: Quick 1-click apply prompts ('High CTR Formula', 'E-commerce Buyer Intent', 'Feature-Focused', 'Minimalist Luxury')

screen_4_collections_seo.title: Collections SEO Optimizer
features: Table of all 142 store collections (e.g., 'Streetwear Hoodies', 'Oversized Tees', 'Acid Wash Denim')
Live collection SEO Title, Collection Meta Description, and H1 Rules
Quick modal editor with live SERP preview for category pages
Batch fill template for collections (e.g. 'Shop {Collection_Title} - UrbanDotted Streetwear Collection')

screen_5_bulk_spreadsheet.title: High-Performance Bulk Spreadsheet Editor
features: Excel/Airtable style editable data grid with keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Enter, Tab)
Columns: Checkbox, ID, Title (locked), SEO Title (editable inline), SEO Title Len, SEO Meta (editable inline), SEO Meta Len, Score, Alt Text Status, Sync Status
Bulk Find & Replace tool (e.g. replace 'Buy Online' with 'Shop Official')
Formula / Pattern Applier (e.g. Apply '{{title}} | Free Shipping | UrbanDotted' to selected 50 rows)
Staged Changes Counter with one-click 'Sync 50 Selected to Shopify'

screen_6_ai_workspace.title: AI SEO Engine & Prompt Playground
features: Batch AI SEO Generator with customizable tone of voice (Urban Streetwear, High-End Minimalist, Technical Specs, Urgency/Hype)
Rule presets: Target keyword placement, Brand suffix format, Call-to-action inclusions
Interactive Prompt Tester with before/after diff preview
Queue Runner with concurrency controls and safety filters

screen_7_job_center.title: Job Center & Background Task Execution
features: Active Job Progress Tracker with animated percentage progress and ETA
Completed, Failed, and Queued batch job history
Detailed execution logs per product ID with error recovery actions

screen_8_csv_import_export.title: CSV Import/Export with Validation Sandbox
features: Drag-and-drop CSV uploader for bulk SEO changes
Preview & Validation Matrix: Flags character count violations and missing fields before applying
Full Catalog SEO Export (formatted for Shopify or UrbanDotted backup)

screen_9_audit_and_rollback.title: Audit Log & One-Click Rollback Engine
features: Chronological history of every SEO title and meta description published
Who changed it (AI Batch Engine, Operator John D., Bulk CSV)
Visual Diff (Red strikethrough for deleted text, Green highlight for added text)
One-click 'Rollback to this version' button with safety confirmation

screen_10_settings.title: Store Connection & SEO Rule Configuration
features: Shopify API Credentials & Webhook Sync Status (Read Product Data, Write SEO Metafields only)
Strict Guardrail Enforcement Toggles (e.g., 'Disallow writing to Shopify price/inventory')
SEO Length Thresholds Configuration (Title Min/Max, Meta Min/Max)
Forbidden Keyword and Duplicate Title Detection Rules

visual_enhancers.tactical_borders: 1px solid border-slate-800 dark:border-slate-800/80 with subtle hover highlights
visual_enhancers.serp_box_styling: Realistic Google SERP mockup with clean white/dark card, Google blue link (#1A0DAB / #8AB4F8), green URL (#006621 / #34A853), and neutral snippet snippet
visual_enhancers.score_rings: Dynamic SVG circular progress meter with gradient stroke reflecting score (Green > 85, Amber 50-84, Red < 50)
visual_enhancers.locked_field_styling: Subtle hatched or muted background with small amber lock badge signaling READ ONLY to operators

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a unique, descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete UrbanDotted SEO Operations platform as an enterprise-grade, high-density React application.
Implement rich mock datasets covering all 35,420 product statistics with realistic simulated server-side pagination, search, issue-queue switching, sorting, and multi-filter criteria.

Implement the full 3-column Live SEO Editor with real-time character counters, progress indicator colors, live Google SERP preview (desktop & mobile toggle), explainable 0-100 score engine with positive and deduction breakdown, and locked Shopify commerce fields.
Provide the interactive Bulk Spreadsheet Editor with inline cell editing, formula applier, and find-and-replace.
Provide the AI SEO Engine workspace with tone selector, target keyword prompts, and 1-click batch generation preview.
Provide Job Center with active animated progress bars, CSV validation matrix, and Audit Log with visual before/after diffs and rollback actions.
Include toast notifications (Sonner) on all actions (Save Draft, Publish to Shopify, Batch Run, Rollback).
Ensure all components are strictly .js / .jsx compatible with Tailwind CSS and Radix/Lucide icons, and include data-testid attributes for automated verification.
